title: Stop Spending Hours Editing Reels. This AI Does It for You.
description:
Submagic is an AI video editor built specifically for short-form content.
Upload a clip and it adds animated captions, cleans up your audio, removes filler words, and pulls in matching B-roll automatically.
Includes an eye contact correction feature that adjusts your gaze in the final video.
Choose from different caption styles, set your format for any platform, and export.
No timeline scrubbing. No manual caption syncing. No hunting for stock footage.

Link: https://www.submagic.co
channel_name: Brock Mesarich | AI for Non Techies
